description: Adverse drug reaction report submitted to the pharmacovigilance triage service.

reporter_type.description: Role or profession of the adverse event reporter.

patient_age.description: Patient age in years at reaction onset (0-120).
patient_age.title: Patient Age

patient_sex.description: Patient biological sex or gender classification.

suspect_drug.description: Name of the suspect active drug substance or medicinal product.
suspect_drug.title: Suspect Drug

drug_start_date.description: Date when the patient began taking the suspect drug (YYYY-MM-DD).
drug_start_date.title: Drug Start Date

event_date.description: Date of onset of the adverse event (YYYY-MM-DD).
event_date.title: Event Date

reaction_description.description: Detailed description of the adverse reaction (max 2000 characters).
reaction_description.title: Reaction Description

outcome.description: Clinical outcome of the adverse drug reaction.

narrative.description: Optional clinical narrative, laboratory findings, or medical history.
narrative.title: Narrative

title: AdverseEventReport
